title: Download File
summary: Native file download or application-owned file preparation action.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

file-name.description: The file's visible name and the name it is saved under. Empty: the link's last part, else «Файл» in the page's language.

file-size.description: The size as text, in the page's units («2,4 МБ»). Empty with href: asked with one HEAD request and written in the page's language.

file-type.description: The file's type in words (PDF, XLSX), shown before the size: «PDF · 2,4 МБ» (decision C25). Never in file-size.

icon.description: Former way to name the file's type by a glyph, which took the download sign's place (decision C25): give the type in file-type. Still drawn and noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01.

href.description: Real resource destination; renders a native anchor when enabled.

download.description: Kept for compatibility: a file link downloads in the same tab whether or not it is given (decision C25); only target="_blank" opens a tab instead.

disabled.description: Render a disabled button with no live destination.

state.description: ready: the file can be fetched. preparing: the application is making it -- a spinner in the sign's place, «Готовим файл…», aria-busy, a press is ignored; when the host sets ready again with an href, the file a person pressed for is fetched once. error: it could not be made -- an error notice «Не удалось подготовить файл» with «Повторить» under the file (decision C25).

error-text.description: More words in the error notice (what went wrong, what to do); the heading is «Не удалось подготовить файл».

target.description: Where the link opens. Empty (default): the file downloads in the same tab. _blank: the file is opened to view in a new tab; the link shows the open-in-new sign and says «(откроется в новой вкладке)» to a screen reader (decision C25).

owner_semantics.application_action: no href renders a button; a press sends the cancelable request sf-file-download-download
owner_semantics.disabled: disabled button with no live destination
owner_semantics.preparing: state preparing: spinner in the sign's place, aria-busy, presses ignored; ready again with an href fetches the file once for the person who pressed
owner_semantics.error: state error: an sf-alert with «Повторить» under the file; its press sends retry

compatibility.size_lookup: an empty size preserves the existing Content-Length lookup

sf-file-download-download.summary: A person pressed the file: the request to fetch it, cancelable. A page that cancels it takes the download over; to prepare the file it sets state="preparing", then ready with the href, or error.

sf-file-download-retry.summary: A person pressed «Повторить» under a file that could not be prepared (vocabulary §5 retry): the host prepares it again and sets the state.

sf-download-file:click.summary: Emitted once for an enabled native destination or application-owned action, from the rendered .sf-download-file root; bubbles to the host, is not composed and not cancelable.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-download for one downloadable resource or an application-owned file preparation action.
do_not: Do not use a button when a stable resource href already exists
Do not leave href on an unavailable file
Do not use the decorative icon as the accessible name
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not put the file type in file-size or in icon: give it in file-type
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-file-download file-name="Отчёт за октябрь.pdf" file-type="PDF" file-size="2,4 МБ" href="/files/report.pdf"></sf-file-download>
